scope: Static review only. No host, provider, database, browser, credential, or test operation was performed.
reviewed_controls: The R5 installer source hash is enforced by an explicit comparison that raises before dynamic import; Python optimization cannot disable the pin.

The installer consumes the canonical refresh-payload.json, requires exactly the three allowed filenames, and validates every decoded source against an embedded SHA-256 before any target write. The owner clarified that the previous payload was renamed aside after hash verification and the canonical filename now contains the final exact payload; the stale-candidate concern from the prior review is therefore closed.

The requalification helper validates the old HMAC against current root-owned config and read-only Ozon credential, then changes only native process generation and the derived HMAC. Pair/config/scope drift fails closed. It re-reads source inputs and process generation before atomic replacement, preserves file ownership/group/mode, fsyncs the file and directory, and emits no private values.

RuntimeDirectory=alisa-native-pair-refresh with mode 0700 supplies a manager-created writable lock directory under ProtectSystem=strict. The helper lock path matches that directory; the only other write path is the root-owned projection directory.

The ExecStartPre hook applies only to the checker. The refresh oneshot is bounded and isolated from network access. The installer verifies checker service readiness, current generation, the real performance adapter/IPC result, and preservation of all protected pointers, service identities, environments, and sandbox properties. Failure cleanup is inode-scoped to files created by this installer.
residual_limitation: A native core restart can race the helper's final generation check and atomic replace. This can leave a stale proof temporarily, but checker resolve validates current process generation on each check and therefore fails closed; the core's PartOf/BindsTo checker restart should invoke the hook again for the new generation. No false Performance identity qualification is enabled by this race.
test_claims: The author-reported 21 fixture tests and successful installation receipts were not independently re-run or inspected in this source-only review.
